acceptanceCriteria: A test with a stalled refs reader shows the goroutine is released on cancel/deadline and no goroutine leak remains.
body:
Source: codex/w5-docs lane (#782, #784, #785).

Observed: readRefsContext in upgradechanges leaves a stalled refs-read goroutine running until process exit. Expected: the refs read is bounded and cancellable so a stalled read is released on context cancellation.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#799 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799; landed by batch PR #799); on main at 10efc02d16e6069d73426e6d6abd860e71ae83ab (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799). Tests named in the PR: doc gates. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: upgradechanges readRefsContext leaks a stalled read goroutine until process exit (docs lane #782/#784/#785)
